_README: CapRover app definitions for one dedicated Constellab instance.
1. Copy this file:  cp caprover-apps.template.json caprover-apps.<customer>.json
2. Fill in every value under 'vars'. None may stay at FILL_ME.
3. ./apply-apps.sh caprover-apps.<customer>.json            -> shows what would be sent
The filled file holds plaintext secrets. Do not commit it.
Every .json here is git-ignored except this template.
Any ${NAME} is replaced by vars.NAME, including inside appName, domains and volumes.
Keys in 'vars' may reference each other.
The environment variables below are the ones the code really reads:
A missing required variable fails the app the first time it is read (at boot for
A feature we do not use has NO variable here rather than a placeholder one: absent is
what makes the API say "Missing config value for 'X'" at the point of use, which is
the failure we want. Do not add a variable back with 'unused' or an empty value — for
the cloud providers and the paid third parties an empty value is refused as well.

_1_domains: --- one registered domain; every name below is derived from it ---
Nothing is served on ${DOMAIN} itself. Each product sits under its own label:
the Space front on space.${DOMAIN} (and *.space.${DOMAIN}, one workspace per
subdomain), the Community front on community.${DOMAIN}. See NEW_INSTANCE.md 1.3.
vars.DOMAIN: FILL_ME: the single registered domain, e.g. acme-constellab.com
_1b_csp: --- Content-Security-Policy of the two fronts: the domains a page may talk to ---
Space separated CSP host sources, NOT a comma separated list. A wildcard source matches
any depth of subdomain, so *.${DOMAIN} covers space., api., community., community-api.
and every workspace at <uuid>.space.${DOMAIN} — one entry for the whole instance.
These MUST be set. Left unset, each image keeps the Gencovery domains it was built with
(*.constellab.space, *.gencovery.com, ...), so every call the front makes to this
instance is blocked by the browser: the app loads and then does nothing, with
'violates the following Content Security Policy directive' in the console.
Third party sources (fonts, recaptcha, algolia, analytics, emoji-mart) are hardcoded in
the images and need nothing here.
vars.CSP_LAB_DOMAINS: FILL_ME: the LAB_ALLOWED_DOMAINS entries as CSP sources, space separated, e.g. *.constellab.app *.gencovery.io
vars._1c_machine: --- the server: where the bind-mounted directories live ---
vars.SPACE_OTHER_JWT_SECRET: FILL_ME: openssl rand -base64 48 (password reset / email validation)
vars._3_shared_key: --- ONE value, read on both sides AND pushed into every lab config ---
vars.MCP_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64: FILL_ME: openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 | base64 -w0
vars._5_object_storage: --- an S3 tenant OF THE CUSTOMER, see NEW_INSTANCE.md pitfall #2 ---
vars.NEW_USER_NOTIF_RECEIVERS: FILL_ME: who is notified when an account is created, comma separated
vars._7_database_ids: --- must exist in the database after step 6 of NEW_INSTANCE.md ---
vars.FOLDER_ID_TO_COPY_ON_SIGNUP: FILL_ME: uuid of a Space folder, or an empty string
vars.GENCOVERY_SPACE_ID: FILL_ME: uuid of the publisher space, must exist in the Community
vars.LAB_ALLOWED_DOMAINS: FILL_ME: domains the labs are created on, comma separated, first one is the default, e.g. constellab.app,gencovery.io
vars._8a_ovh: default provider for lab provisioning, and the DNS-01 challenge
_8b_azure_outscale_gcp: Azure, Outscale and GCP are NOT configured on this instance: their variables are
deliberately absent, not empty. An absent variable makes the API fail with
"Missing config value for 'X'" the moment a lab is provisioned on that provider,
which is the intended, readable failure. To enable one, add back its variables here
AND in the space-api envVars block below:
GCP_PROJECT_ID is also read by the captcha (reCAPTCHA Enterprise), independently of
lab provisioning: setting CAPTCHA_SITE_KEY below requires it and
_9_optional_third_parties: Same rule: a third party we are not subscribed to has no variable at all, so the
failure names it. OPENAI_API_KEY, YOUTUBE_API_KEY, YOUTUBE_TUTORIAL_PLAYLIST_ID and
REFLEX_ACCESS_TOKEN are read by getNonEmptyConfigString and belong here when used.
The values left empty below are front-end variables, where empty means 'feature off'.
vars._10_space_buckets: --- S3 bucket names of the Space API, to create in the customer's tenant ---
vars.SPACE_BUCKET_DB_BACKUP: FILL_ME: where the Space's nightly database dump is written, e.g. acme-db-backup
vars._10_community_buckets: --- S3 bucket names, to create in the customer's tenant ---
vars.BUCKET_DB_BACKUP: FILL_ME: where the nightly database dump is written, e.g. acme-db-backup
vars._11_images: --- the four product images. 'skip' means apply-apps.sh leaves them alone; step 7 deploys them. The infra images above are pinned and deployed by apply-apps.sh. ---

apps._role: Redis shared by space-api and community-api (BullMQ). Internal, never exposed.
apps._command: redis:7 ignores REDIS_PASSWORD. Without --requirepass the server takes no password at all, so the Args below are what actually set it; the env var is kept only for anything reading the app definition.

apps._role: MariaDB 10 for the Space. Internal, never exposed.
apps._charset: The server default has to be utf8mb4: MYSQL_DATABASE below creates the schema with it, and MariaDB 10 would otherwise default to latin1.
apps._init: MYSQL_DATABASE / MYSQL_USER only act on an empty data directory, at the very first boot. On an existing volume they are ignored and the schema has to be created by hand.

apps._role: MariaDB 10 for the Community. Internal, never exposed.
apps._charset: The server default has to be utf8mb4: MYSQL_DATABASE below creates the schema with it, and MariaDB 10 would otherwise default to latin1.
apps._init: MYSQL_DATABASE / MYSQL_USER only act on an empty data directory, at the very first boot. On an existing volume they are ignored and the schema has to be created by hand.

apps._role: SQL access to both databases. Used in step 6 (schema and seed).
apps._note: Reachable at adminer.infra.<DOMAIN>; the server name to type is srv-captain--space-db.

apps._role: cn-space-api. Image published by the cn_* tag of monorepo-back.
apps.serviceUpdateOverride:
# Reduce downtime between deploiements
TaskTemplate:
  ContainerSpec:
    StopGracePeriod: 15000000000
UpdateConfig:
  Order: start-first
  Parallelism: 1
  FailureAction: rollback
  Delay: 5000000000

apps._role: hn-community-api. Image published by the hn_* tag of monorepo-back.
apps.serviceUpdateOverride:
# Reduce downtime between deploiements
TaskTemplate:
  ContainerSpec:
    StopGracePeriod: 15000000000
UpdateConfig:
  Order: start-first
  Parallelism: 1
  FailureAction: rollback
  Delay: 5000000000

apps._role: ca-space-front. Image published by the ca_* tag of monorepo-front.
apps._nginx: The only app with a hand-written nginx config: it serves ${SPACE_DOMAIN} and *.${SPACE_DOMAIN} from the wildcard certificate issued outside CapRover. See step 8.

apps._role: ha-community-front (Node SSR). Image published by the ha_* tag of monorepo-front.
